content: By being born in the digital era, Aiguille can build an integrated product-service offering that is more seamless and powerful than the retrofitted solutions of the older players. The "better piece of steel" is not obsolete; it is the necessary foundation for the "better data" that customers increasingly demand. In summary, the competitive environment for mining GET is dominated by a small number of powerful, OEM-affiliated and specialist firms that compete on a combination of product performance, supply chain reliability, and integrated service offerings. For Aiguille Tools & Edges, a direct assault on these incumbents is ill-advised.
